articles.desc: When coffee is spilled at an office block in a futuristic enclave of Singapore, AI-powered cameras and sensors detect it and send a cleaning robot right away. A district-wide "open digital platform" coordinates the robots and connects different locations, gathering data from thousands of cameras and sensors on everything from air temperature to foot traffic.

The upcoming economic indicators hint at potential interest rate increases by the Federal Reserve in December. Meanwhile, the yen has seen a slight uptick against the dollar, while the euro holds steady as traders await accounts from the ECB meeting.

articles.title: South Korea's central bank resumes tightening with quarter-point hike

Economic growth has been upgraded to 3.9% for this year and 4.1% for next year. Policymakers remain cautious due to elevated inflation and a heated housing market.

Intermediaries are instructed to report account closures promptly to maintain accurate KYC records. Investors are also advised against engaging with grey market premium figures for IPOs.

Corporate trading members will offer this facility based on certain conditions and net worth requirements. Public comments on the proposal are invited until December 16.

The Reserve Bank of India's upcoming decision will significantly affect market movements and trends.

The digital payments firm has also reported significant revenue growth and is now profitable at the group level.

articles.desc: The Indian rupee has shown significant strength against the US dollar, propelled by robust foreign portfolio investments. Surging to an eight-month high on Thursday, it closed at 92.23 per dollar. Analysts connect this to favorable market dynamics, including falling crude oil prices. With record foreign investments in Indian stocks this month, the market exudes increased confidence, suggesting a potential for continued rupee appreciation if circumstances remain favorable.
